title: Portability T5d: PORTABILITY docs and fresh-VM validation
problem: With T5a (paths/interpreter), T5b (shell hygiene), and T5c (bootstrap + stable project key) landed, the repo should be portable but nothing documents the setup flow for a new machine, no migration guide exists for users moving their state between machines, and the portability claim has not been validated end-to-end on a fresh OS.
description:
Fourth and final phase of the portability epic (T5), follows T5a -> T5b -> T5c.

DEPENDENCY: Do not start until T5c's pipeline/* branch is merged to master.

Scope of work:
1. PORTABILITY.md at repo root:
   - Prereqs: minimum Python version, git, required PATH entries
   - Bootstrap steps: clone -> pip install -r requirements.txt -> python scripts/bootstrap.py -> done
   - Explanation of local-vs-synced state (what lives in ~/.claude/projects/<key>/, what's in the repo)
   - Machine migration walkthrough: export state from machine A, import on machine B
   - Troubleshooting: common issues (PATH python mismatch, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR not set, etc.)
2. Migration guide (can be a section in PORTABILITY.md or separate file):
   - Export: tar/zip of ~/.claude/projects/<key>/ (notes.jsonl, learnings.jsonl, memory/, budgeter logs)
   - Import: extract on target machine after bootstrap
   - Edge cases: session IDs, stale file paths inside memory files
3. Acceptance test (manual, documented for reproducibility):
   - Spin up a fresh Linux VM (or fresh macOS/Windows user account if VM not available)
   - Clone the repo
   - Run bootstrap per PORTABILITY.md
   - Start a Claude Code session, exercise 3-5 representative tool calls, verify hooks fire and notes persist
   - Document the results in the PR description with screenshots or terminal output
   - If any step fails, fix the root cause in T5a/b/c territory and land a follow-up
4. CLAUDE.md update: add a pointer to PORTABILITY.md from the Portability section.

Definition of done:
- PORTABILITY.md exists, covers prereqs/bootstrap/state/migration/troubleshooting
- Migration guide documented with working export/import commands
- Fresh-VM acceptance test run and documented, with evidence (logs or screenshots in PR)
- CLAUDE.md points to PORTABILITY.md
- The portability epic scope item list (from the original epic) is fully satisfied

Out of scope: anything requiring changes back in T5a/b/c — if the fresh-VM test reveals a gap, file a follow-up ticket, don't try to fix it in this phase.
scope: PORTABILITY.md (new), CLAUDE.md (portability section pointer), optional scripts/export_state.py + scripts/import_state.py if migration is scripted. NO changes to hooks, subprocess code, bootstrap, or project-key logic (all landed in prior phases). If the acceptance test reveals gaps in prior phases, file follow-ups rather than fixing inline.
context: Phase 4 (final) of the portability epic split. Depends on T5a, T5b, and T5c all landed. After this, the portability epic is complete. Note that the fresh-VM test is inherently manual and cannot be run inside the pipeline's executor — the pipeline should produce the documentation and export/import scripts; the user will run the fresh-VM test out-of-band and attach results to the PR before merging.
